mapper.sql: r.id, r.title, r.category_id, c.name AS category_name, r.description, r.file_url, r.owner_id, r.owner_name, r.like_count, r.download_count, r.view_count, COALESCE(fav_count.favorite_count, 0) AS favorite_count, r.visibility, r.allow_download, r.created_at, r.updated_at
mapper.select: SELECT FROM resource r LEFT JOIN resource_category c ON r.category_id = c.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT resource_id, COUNT(*) AS favorite_count FROM resource_favorite GROUP BY resource_id ) fav_count ON r.id = fav_count.resource_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO resource( title, category_id, description, file_url, owner_id, owner_name, like_count, download_count, view_count, visibility, allow_download, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{title}, #{categoryId}, #{description}, #{fileUrl}, #{ownerId}, #{ownerName}, #{likeCount}, #{downloadCount}, #{viewCount}, #{visibility}, #{allowDownload}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE resource SET download_count = download_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE resource SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE resource SET visibility = #{visibility}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM resource WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId}
